title: whoever / whatever / whenever / however в придаточных

why: Слова с -ever выражают «неважно кто / что / когда / где / как». По-русски это «кто бы ни», «что бы ни», «когда бы ни», «где бы ни», «как бы ни». Они позволяют одной фразой сказать: результат или правило не зависят от выбора.
formation: • who + ever = whoever (кто бы ни; любой, кто)
• what + ever = whatever (что бы ни; всё, что)
• which + ever = whichever (какой бы ни, из ограниченного набора)
• when + ever = whenever (когда бы ни; в любое время, когда)
• where + ever = wherever (где бы ни; куда бы ни)
Схема: whoever / whatever / whenever / wherever + подлежащее/сказуемое в обычном порядке слов.
However + прилагательное/наречие + подлежащее + глагол: however hard you try.
usage: 1. «Неважно кто / что» (уступка): Whatever you decide, I'll support you. (Что бы ты ни решил, я тебя поддержу.)

2. «Любой, кто / всё, что» (слово работает как подлежащее или дополнение): Whoever finishes first gets a prize. (Тот, кто закончит первым, получит приз.) Take whatever you need. (Бери всё, что нужно.)
3. «В любое время / в любом месте»: Call me whenever you need help. (Звони, когда бы тебе ни понадобилась помощь.) I can work wherever there is Wi-Fi. (Я могу работать везде, где есть Wi-Fi.)
4. «Как бы ни»: However hard I try, I can't understand this code. (Как бы я ни старался, я не понимаю этот код.) You can do it however you like. (Делай это так, как тебе нравится.)
5. Whichever вместо whatever, когда выбор ограничен: Take whichever of the two books you like. (Бери ту из двух книг, которая нравится.)
signalWords: no matter who / what / when / where / how (синонимичная замена: no matter who calls = whoever calls); «неважно», «любой», «в любом случае». Для however часто стоит прилагательное сразу после: however busy, however late.
mistakes: ✗ Whenever you will arrive, call me → ✓ Whenever you arrive, call me (после -ever будущее время не нужно, как после when/if)
✗ However is hard the task, we'll finish → ✓ However hard the task is, we'll finish (порядок слов обычный, а не как в вопросе)
✗ Whatever hard you work → ✓ However hard you work (для прилагательного нужно however, а не whatever)
✗ Whoever are interested can join → ✓ Whoever is interested can join (whoever считается единственным числом)
✗ I'll do how you want → ✓ I'll do it however you want (how без -ever так не используется)
remember: -ever = «неважно кто/что/когда/где/как»: whoever calls, whatever you say, however hard you try; после них время как после when, без will.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте whoever, whatever, whichever, whenever, wherever или however

items.prompt: ___ you need help, just call me.
items.answer: Whenever

items.prompt: You can choose ___ color you like.
items.answer: whichever / whatever

items.prompt: ___ broke the server must fix it.
items.answer: Whoever

items.prompt: I'll follow you ___ you go.
items.answer: wherever

items.prompt: ___ hard I try, I can't understand this code.
items.answer: However

items.prompt: ___ you decide, I'll support you.
items.answer: Whatever

items.prompt: Take the train or the bus, ___ is faster.
items.answer: whichever

items.prompt: ___ you ask, the answer will be the same.
items.answer: Whoever

items.prompt: (a) Whatever (b) Whoever (c) However opened the door left it open.
items.answer: Whoever

items.prompt: I'll buy (a) whoever (b) whatever (c) wherever you recommend.
items.answer: whatever

items.prompt: (a) However (b) Whatever (c) Whenever expensive it is, I want it.
items.answer: However

items.prompt: She feels at home (a) whoever (b) wherever (c) whichever she is.
items.answer: wherever

items.prompt: There are two plans. We'll take (a) whoever (b) whichever (c) however is cheaper.
items.answer: whichever

items.prompt: (a) Whenever (b) Whoever (c) Whatever I see him, he's smiling.
items.answer: Whenever

items.prompt: He does it (a) however (b) whichever (c) whoever he likes.
items.answer: however

items.prompt: You can invite (a) whoever (b) whatever (c) however you want.
items.answer: whoever

items.prompt: It doesn't matter who calls; don't open the door.
items.answer: Whoever calls, don't open the door.

items.prompt: It doesn't matter what you say; he won't change his mind.
items.answer: Whatever you say, he won't change his mind.

items.prompt: It doesn't matter where you live; you can work remotely.
items.answer: Wherever you live, you can work remotely.

items.prompt: Any time you visit, you're welcome.
items.answer: Whenever you visit, you're welcome.

items.prompt: It doesn't matter how busy she is; she always replies.
items.answer: However busy she is, she always replies.

items.prompt: Any person who finishes first gets a prize.
items.answer: Whoever finishes first gets a prize.

items.prompt: It doesn't matter which one you choose; both are good.
items.answer: Whichever one you choose, both are good. / Whichever you choose, both are good.

items.prompt: In any place where there is Wi-Fi, I can work.
items.answer: Wherever there is Wi-Fi, I can work.

items.prompt: Whatever calls, tell them I'm in a meeting.
items.answer: Whoever calls, tell them I'm in a meeting.

items.prompt: Whenever you will arrive, call me.
items.answer: Whenever you arrive, call me.

items.prompt: However is hard the task, we'll finish it.
items.answer: However hard the task is, we'll finish it.

items.prompt: Wherever you will go, I'll find you.
items.answer: Wherever you go, I'll find you.

items.prompt: Whatever hard you work, you can't finish this today.
items.answer: However hard you work, you can't finish this today.

items.prompt: Whichever of the two you will choose is fine.
items.answer: Whichever of the two you choose is fine.

items.prompt: Whoever are interested can join us.
items.answer: Whoever is interested can join us.

items.prompt: I'll do how you want.
items.answer: I'll do it however you want. / I'll do whatever you want.

items.prompt: Кто бы ни позвонил, скажи, что я перезвоню.
items.answer: Whoever calls, tell them I'll call back.

items.prompt: Что бы ты ни решил, я тебя поддержу.
items.answer: Whatever you decide, I'll support you.

items.prompt: Я могу работать везде, где есть интернет.
items.answer: I can work wherever there is internet. / I can work wherever there is an internet connection.

items.prompt: Как бы ты ни старался, ты не успеешь.
items.answer: However hard you try, you won't make it in time. / However hard you try, you won't make it.

items.prompt: Звони мне, когда бы тебе ни понадобилась помощь.
items.answer: Call me whenever you need help.

items.prompt: Выбери любую из двух книг.
items.answer: Take whichever book you like. / Choose whichever of the two books you like.

items.prompt: Кто бы это ни сделал, он ошибся.
items.answer: Whoever did it made a mistake.

items.prompt: Как бы поздно я ни вернулся, она меня ждёт.
items.answer: However late I get back, she is waiting for me. / However late I get back, she waits for me.
